Manatal ATS is worth it for small recruiting teams that need basic applicant tracking at a low price point. It falls short for anyone who needs AI-powered candidate sourcing, multi-channel outreach, or a large talent database. Starting at $15 per user per month on annual billing, it's one of the most affordable ATS options on the market.

That $15 plan has one catch: it caps you at 15 open jobs and 10,000 candidates. And API access doesn't unlock until the $55/user/month Enterprise Plus tier.

This guide breaks down Manatal pricing 2026 across all four plans, maps out the costs that aren't obvious from the pricing page, and compares Manatal against five alternatives with different pricing models. Before committing to an ATS, you'll know exactly what Manatal includes at each tier - and where its limitations might push you toward a different tool.

> **TL;DR:**
>
> - **Cheap per seat, but gated by plan.** Annual pricing runs $15/user/mo (Professional), $35/user/mo (Enterprise), and $55/user/mo (Enterprise Plus) per [Manatal](https://www.manatal.com/pricing).
> - **Entry tier has hard caps.** Professional limits you to 15 open jobs and 10,000 candidates before you must upgrade.
> - **API access is top-tier only.** Integrations via API are locked to the $55/user Enterprise Plus plan.
> - **No candidate sourcing database.** Manatal is a CRM-first ATS. It tracks inbound applicants but doesn't proactively search external talent databases or run multi-channel outreach.
> - **Flat-rate sourcing tools complement or replace it.** [Pin](https://www.pin.com/) starts at $100/mo flat (no per-user pricing) and adds 850M+ profile search with automated outreach.

## What Is Manatal?

Founded in 2019 by Jeremy Fichet (CEO) and Yassine Belmamoun (CTO), Manatal is a cloud-based applicant tracking system and recruitment CRM headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand. In February 2022, it raised a $5.1 million seed round from Sequoia India's Surge program, according to [PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/recruitment-saas-platform-manatal-raises-us5-1-million-in-funding-to-transform-hiring-globally-301479179.html).

Currently serving 1,000+ clients across 130+ countries, Manatal positions itself as an affordable ATS alternative to enterprise tools like Greenhouse, Lever, and Bullhorn. Its core strengths are applicant tracking, pipeline management, AI-powered candidate recommendations, and resume parsing. It's a CRM-first tool - not an AI sourcing platform - which shapes both what it can do and what it charges.

That distinction matters for pricing. Per-seat pricing at Manatal reflects its scope: it tracks and scores candidates who are already in your pipeline. It doesn't proactively search external databases, run multi-channel outreach, or automate interview scheduling the way dedicated recruiting platforms do.

### What Do Manatal Reviews Say?

Manatal reviews average 4.3/5 on [G2](https://www.g2.com/products/manatal/reviews) and 4.6/5 on [Capterra](https://www.capterra.com/p/181145/Manatal/reviews/) - solid scores for an entry-priced ATS. Most praise in a typical Manatal ATS review focuses on ease of setup and a clean interface. Consistently, users flag limited reporting, search constraints, and the lack of a built-in sourcing database. How much those gaps matter depends on your workflow.

## What Does Manatal Cost in 2026?

Per-user billing defines how Manatal ATS pricing in 2026 works. Manatal pricing per user per month ranges from $15 on annual Professional billing to $59 for month-to-month Enterprise Plus, across three published tiers plus a custom enterprise option, according to [Manatal's pricing page](https://www.manatal.com/pricing). Annual billing saves roughly 20% compared to month-to-month.

See [Jobvite Pricing 2026: What Recruiters Need to Know](https://www.pin.com/blog/jobvite-pricing/) for a pricing-specific comparison.

Full breakdown by plan:

| Plan | Annual Billing | Monthly Billing | Open Jobs | Candidate Limit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Professional | $15/user/mo | $19/user/mo | 15 | 10,000 |
| Enterprise | $35/user/mo | $39/user/mo | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| Enterprise Plus | $55/user/mo | $59/user/mo | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| Custom | Contact sales | Contact sales | Unlimited | Unlimited |

Those per-user numbers look low - and they are, compared to enterprise ATS platforms that charge $10,000+ annually. Add team members, though, and the math changes fast. A five-person recruiting team on the Enterprise plan pays $175/month ($2,100/year). Bump that to 10 recruiters and you're at $350/month ($4,200/year). That's still affordable, but it's no longer the "under $50/month" deal the pricing page implies at first glance.

### Monthly vs Annual: What's the Real Difference?

Monthly billing costs roughly 20-27% more depending on the tier. Here's the annual total for a single recruiter on each plan:

| Plan | Annual Billing (total/yr) | Monthly Billing (total/yr) | You Save (Annual) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Professional | $180/yr | $228/yr | $48/yr per user |
| Enterprise | $420/yr | $468/yr | $48/yr per user |
| Enterprise Plus | $660/yr | $708/yr | $48/yr per user |

Savings hold consistent across tiers - roughly $4/user/month. On annual billing, a five-person team on Enterprise saves $240/year. Not dramatic, but enough to notice. Committing upfront is the trade-off: annual plans are billed in full at the start of the billing cycle. Cancellation and refund policy terms aren't publicly disclosed, so confirm them before signing.

A 14-day free trial requires no credit card. During the trial, you get access to all plan features - but with restrictions. Posting to job boards, sending mass emails, running email automations, and generating AI job descriptions are all disabled until you upgrade.

## What Features Unlock at Each Manatal Tier?

Based on [Manatal's published feature matrix](https://www.manatal.com/pricing) and verified against user reviews on [G2](https://www.g2.com/products/manatal/reviews) (2025), the pricing tiers differ significantly in what they include. Professional covers the basics - AI candidate recommendations, resume parsing, a LinkedIn Chrome extension, and posting to 19 free job boards. Several features that recruiters rely on daily remain locked behind higher tiers, however.

At each level, here's what's included and what isn't:

| Feature | Professional ($15) | Enterprise ($35) | Enterprise Plus ($55) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| AI Candidate Recommendations | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Resume Parsing | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| LinkedIn Chrome Extension | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Free Job Board Posting (19 boards) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Open Jobs | 15 max | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| Candidate Database | 10,000 max | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| Workflow Automations | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Advanced Reports | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ |
| API / Zapier Access | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ |
| SSO Login | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ |
| User Groups & Permissions | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ |
| Priority Support | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ |

API access is the biggest gap. Anyone who needs Manatal to connect to their existing HR tech stack - HRIS, payroll system, or internal tools - is locked into the $55/user/month Enterprise Plus tier. That's a deal-breaker for anyone [building an integrated recruiting tech stack](https://www.pin.com/blog/build-recruiting-tech-stack-2026/) and needing data flowing between platforms.

Workflow automations are also locked behind the Enterprise tier. On Professional, every status change, email follow-up, and pipeline move is manual. Managing more than a handful of active roles makes that manual overhead add up fast.

## What Are Manatal's Hidden Costs?

Manatal's main hidden costs are per-seat billing that scales with team size, capped mass-email credits, and premium job-board fees charged separately. Published pricing is more transparent than at platforms like Bullhorn or Greenhouse that don't show prices at all, but those costs still aren't spelled out on the pricing page.

**Per-user billing adds up quickly.** Unlike flat-rate platforms where one price covers the whole team, Manatal charges per seat. A 10-person agency on the Enterprise plan pays $4,200/year. Add five more recruiters next quarter and that jumps to $6,300. Fast-growing teams need to budget for this scaling cost.

**Mass email credits are capped.** Multiple [Capterra reviewers](https://www.capterra.com/p/181145/Manatal/reviews/) flag that Manatal limits monthly credits for mass outreach campaigns. One reviewer specifically noted wanting more than 1,000 free monthly credits for marketing campaigns. If you're doing high-volume candidate outreach, you'll likely hit this ceiling.

**Premium job board postings cost extra.** The 19 free job boards are included, but premium boards (LinkedIn job slots, for example) carry separate fees charged by the board provider. Those costs sit outside your Manatal subscription but are still part of your total recruiting spend.

**No free plan exists.** After the 14-day trial ends, there's no free-forever tier. After the trial, access ends unless you convert to a paid plan. Platforms like Pin, by contrast, offer a free tier with no credit card required and no expiration.

Pin's automated outreach runs across email, LinkedIn, and SMS in a single workflow - no credit limits, no per-message caps. High-volume outreach teams will notice that difference in pricing model most. [**Compare Pin's flat-rate pricing for your team**](https://www.pin.com/).

## What Can't Manatal Do?

Manatal can't search external candidate databases, run multi-channel outreach sequences, or match non-English resumes with full accuracy - it's a CRM-first ATS, not an AI sourcing platform. As a solid ATS and [recruitment CRM](https://www.pin.com/blog/best-recruitment-crm-agencies/) at a competitive price, it covers the basics well. But the gap between what Manatal does and what dedicated AI recruiting tools offer is significant, and it's the most important consideration for teams deciding whether the low price point is actually a bargain.

In practice, Manatal's limitations show up in four specific areas:

**No external candidate database.** Without a proprietary talent pool, Manatal relies on importing candidates from LinkedIn via a Chrome extension or waiting for applicants through job boards. Proactively searching millions of passive candidate profiles - what dedicated sourcing platforms do - simply isn't part of Manatal's scope. By comparison, Pin's database includes 850M+ candidate profiles with 100% coverage in North America and Europe.

**No multi-channel outreach sequences.** Basic email functionality exists in Manatal, but sequences that combine email, LinkedIn messages, and SMS into a single campaign are absent. That gap matters. Across outreach tracked in Pin's data, LinkedIn messages earn a 16.9% per-touch response rate versus 4.96% for automated email - a 3.4x difference. Email-only tools leave that higher-responding channel untapped, so high-volume teams need a separate platform on top of Manatal.

**AI recommendations are English-dependent.** According to user reviews on [G2](https://www.g2.com/products/manatal/reviews) and Manatal's own documentation, the AI scoring and candidate matching work best with English-language resumes. Non-English hiring markets will see degraded AI accuracy. Career pages are also limited to English and Spanish only.

### Day-to-Day UX and Performance Gaps

**Search limitations.** Users can't combine Boolean search and Advanced Search simultaneously. You have to pick one method or the other - which limits how precisely you can filter candidates when your requirements are specific.

**Reporting gaps.** Multiple reviewers across [G2](https://www.g2.com/products/manatal/reviews) and [Capterra](https://www.capterra.com/p/181145/Manatal/reviews/) flag limited recruitment metrics and a lack of detailed performance reporting. Teams needing to measure [recruiting ROI of AI tools](https://www.pin.com/blog/recruiting-roi-ai-tools/) or present hiring analytics to stakeholders will find Manatal's built-in reports insufficient.

**UX friction in daily workflows.** Reviewers consistently note two pain points: you can't save and share search filters (every search requires re-entering parameters from scratch), and clicking a notification doesn't navigate directly to the relevant candidate profile. Daily, those small inefficiencies compound into real time drains for recruiters processing dozens of candidates.

**AI match accuracy is inconsistent.** Multiple G2 reviewers report that Manatal's AI-assigned match percentages don't always reflect actual job fit. Scoring can flag candidates as strong matches when their experience doesn't align with the role requirements. Recruiters still need to manually review every AI recommendation as a result - which reduces the time savings the AI feature is supposed to deliver.

## Who Is Manatal a Good Fit For?

Small in-house teams processing mostly inbound applicants are Manatal's best fit - not teams that need proactive AI sourcing or automated multi-channel outreach. When your primary need is organizing applicants, tracking pipeline stages, and managing a small number of open roles, the Professional plan at $15/user/month is hard to beat on price alone.

**A reasonable fit for these teams:**

-   Small in-house teams (1-5 recruiters) that mostly process inbound applicants and don't rely on outbound sourcing
-   Early-stage startups that need a basic ATS and aren't yet hiring at volume
-   Teams that already have a separate sourcing tool and just need a pipeline tracker
-   Agencies managing fewer than 15 active roles who can stay within the Professional plan's job cap

**Where Manatal falls short:**

-   Anyone who needs to search an external candidate database to source passive talent
-   Recruiters running automated outreach campaigns across email, LinkedIn, and SMS
-   Agencies managing 20+ open roles (the $15 plan's 15-job cap forces an immediate upgrade)
-   Companies hiring in non-English markets where AI accuracy drops
-   Organizations that need API integrations but can't justify $55/user/month per recruiter

Anyone in that second group - especially when sourcing passive candidates and running outreach sequences are core to the workflow - will find the value equation shifts. Platforms designed specifically for AI-powered sourcing and automated outreach deliver more for the money, even at a higher sticker price.

### The Real Cost of Manatal + Add-On Tools

Growing recruiting teams often hit this scenario. You start with Manatal Enterprise at $35/user/month for applicant tracking. But you also need a sourcing tool to find passive candidates ($100-$300/month). You need outreach automation for multi-channel sequences ($100-$200/month). And you probably want interview scheduling software ($50-$100/month).

At five recruiters, the monthly breakdown is roughly:

-   Manatal Enterprise: $175/month ($2,100/year)
-   Sourcing tool: $150/month ($1,800/year)
-   Outreach automation: $150/month ($1,800/year)
-   Scheduling tool: $75/month ($900/year)
-   **Total: $550/month ($6,600/year)**

Lowest sticker price isn't always most cost-effective. What matters is cost per outcome: sourced candidates, scheduled interviews, filled positions.

## Manatal Pricing FAQ

### Does Manatal have a free plan?

No free plan exists. It offers a 14-day free trial with no credit card required, but there's no permanent free tier. Paid plans start at $15/user/month (annual) or $19/user/month (monthly) once the trial ends. Alternatives like Pin and [Zoho Recruit](/blog/zoho-recruit-pricing/) offer free plans with no expiration date.

### How much does Manatal cost for a 10-person team?

On Manatal's Enterprise plan, a 10-person team pays $350/month ($4,200/year) on annual billing. On the Professional plan, the same team pays $150/month ($1,800/year), but that plan caps open jobs at 15 and candidates at 10,000 - limits most active 10-person recruiting teams would hit quickly.

### Can you use Manatal's API on the Professional plan?

No. API access, Zapier integrations, and SSO are all restricted to the Manatal Enterprise Plus tier at $55/user/month (annual billing). Syncing Manatal data with other tools in your tech stack locks you into the highest-priced tier regardless of team size.

### Is Manatal good for recruiting agencies?

For agency use cases, Manatal works when the primary need is applicant tracking and pipeline management. It supports multi-client setups and offers a CRM-like interface. However, agencies that depend on outbound sourcing and automated candidate outreach will find Manatal's capabilities limited compared to platforms with built-in candidate databases and multi-channel sequence automation.

### How is Manatal different from a CRM?

CRM-style features for tracking client relationships and candidate pipelines are built into Manatal, but it differs from a standalone recruiting CRM in one key way: scope. A CRM manages people you're already in contact with - Manatal does that well. What it doesn't do is proactively search external databases to find new candidates or run automated multi-channel outreach to engage them. Dedicated AI sourcing platforms cover those outbound workflows. Covering both inbound pipeline management and outbound AI sourcing typically means pairing Manatal with a platform like Pin to handle the full top-of-funnel workflow.

### What's the best AI recruiting tool for under $200 per month?

Pin's Starter plan costs $100/month and includes AI sourcing across 850M+ candidate profiles, automated multi-channel outreach (email, LinkedIn, SMS), interview scheduling, and a free tier. Unlike per-user platforms, Pin's flat rate covers the whole team. For a full comparison, see our [2026 AI recruiting platform comparison](/blog/ai-recruitment-platform-comparison/).

## The Bottom Line on Manatal Pricing

At $15/user/month, Manatal delivers on its promise as a low-cost ATS for basic pipeline management. Among the most affordable ways to get applicant tracking, resume parsing, and basic AI candidate scoring into a workflow, it offers genuine value for small teams processing mostly inbound applicants.

That pricing advantage narrows - and eventually reverses - as needs grow. The Professional plan's 15-job cap forces growing teams onto the $35 tier. API integrations require the $55 tier. And the biggest limitation isn't a tier restriction at all: Manatal simply doesn't offer external candidate sourcing, multi-channel outreach automation, or the kind of AI-driven talent discovery that modern recruiting demands.

For teams that need sourcing, outreach, and scheduling in a single workflow, Pin delivers the best value at any team size. Rated 4.8/5 on G2, it fills positions in an average of 14 days - the fastest time-to-fill of any AI recruiting platform. Understanding Manatal pricing is step one. Whether per-user ATS-only pricing fits your workflow and budget is the real question, or whether a purpose-built AI recruiting platform closes that gap more efficiently.
